title: Dependence properties of bivariate copula families

bindings.note: The actual classical boundary and rectangle conditions admit a unique representing copula measure. This compiled representation bridge covers the definition in the first sentence, not the following general Sklar theorem or every proposition in this paragraph.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv v3 Appendix A.4.1/equation (23); published DOI 10.1515/demo-2024-0002 Appendix A.4.1/equation (A7)
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The Appendix A.4.1 Fréchet parameter constraint and equation (23) Mardia W weight yield the intended copula mixtures.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: The printed Fréchet inequality is reversed and the Mardia W weight can be negative; the literal parameterizations are excluded from the Lean constructors.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: Theorems use the valid Fréchet simplex and nonnegative Mardia W weight.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv v3 and published DOI 10.1515/demo-2024-0002, Table 5 and Appendix A.4.2
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: Increasing the W weight increases the Fréchet copula in lower orthant order.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: Lean gives an explicit independence-to-W counterexample to that direction.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The proved order increases with M weight and decreases with W weight.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv v3 and published DOI 10.1515/demo-2024-0002, Table 5 and Appendix A.4.1
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The printed Mardia CI/CD endpoint classifications omit independence, and singular endpoints have a Lebesgue TP2 density.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: Lean proves the missing theta=0 CI/CD cases and shows every nonzero M or W weight has a singular component.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The corrected CI/CD classifications include theta=0; a TP2 Lebesgue density exists only at independence.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv:2310.17307v3, Table 3; journal correspondence for this cell not checked
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The Ali–Mikhail–Haq lower-tail coefficient is zero also at theta=1.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: Lean proves the theta=1 copula is Clayton(1) and its lower-tail coefficient is 1/2.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The lower-tail coefficient is zero for -1<=theta<1 and 1/2 at theta=1; the upper-tail coefficient is always zero.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv:2310.17307v3, Table 6; journal correspondence for this cell not checked
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: Lean integrates the actual CDF and refutes the printed formula at theta=2.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The logarithmic term is 2*theta*log(theta)/(theta-1)^2 for theta>0, theta!=1; at theta=1 rho=0.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv:2310.17307v3, Tables 1, 4-5 and Appendix A.4.1; corresponding journal cells not checked
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The printed Raftery CDF is a copula, no Raftery parameter has a density, its non-independent members lack TP2 density, and its upper tail is zero throughout the closed parameter interval.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: The printed CDF is below the lower Frechet bound at delta=1/2, u=v=7/8. Independence has a TP2 density; comonotonicity has upper tail one.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The literal CDF is formally refuted. An actual copula construction verifies the CDF with the missing factor 1/(1+delta) restored and verifies the stated endpoint identities. Absolute continuity and TP2 density hold exactly for delta<1; a non-independent delta=1/2 member refutes the printed exclusion. CI and PQD hold throughout [0,1], and CD/NQD hold only at zero.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv:2310.17307v3, Table 6, PDF page 19 and HTML; journal cell not checked
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The printed Gaussian xi expression has a real arcsine argument on the full signed correlation range.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: Its literal argument 1/2+r^2/(1+r) exceeds one throughout -1<r<-1/2 and equals 11/4 at r=-3/4, an admissible Gaussian correlation.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The domain failure is formally checked. Moreover, the literal formula is refuted at the admissible pair r=+/-1/2 by its unequal values, contradicting the proved evenness of actual Gaussian xi. Both arcsine arguments are within [-1,1]. The corrected formula (3/pi)*arcsin((1+r^2)/2)-1/2 is proved for every r in [-1,1].

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv:2310.17307v3, Appendix A.3.3; journal passage not checked
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: Both Gaussian tail coefficients are one at both signed singular correlations.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: At r=-1 the actual Gaussian copula is countermonotonic, and both checked tail limits are zero.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: Both coefficients are zero for -1<=r<1 and one at r=1. Uniqueness of limits formally excludes the printed value at r=-1.

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv v3 HTML Table 1; PDF and journal cell unchecked
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The printed Student-t density with correlation rho in the dimension slots agrees pointwise with the actual standard bivariate density.
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: At rho=0, nu=2 and the origin, the literal printed expression is 1, whereas the proved actual density is 1/(2*pi)<1. Lean refutes the universal pointwise formula.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: The actual joint law has the standard dimension-two density with exponent -(nu+2)/2 and normalizing factor 1/(2*pi*sqrt(1-rho^2)).

sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: The t-EV copula tends to a Husler-Reiss copula as nu tends to infinity (fixed rho).
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: For fixed rho in (-1,1) the Lean proof gives the independence limit, and every Husler-Reiss member with delta>0 differs from independence (tEV_printed_infinity_limit_false).

sourceDiscrepancies.version: arXiv v3 Table 5 (Tawn and Joe-EV TP2 cells)
sourceDiscrepancies.unverified_claim: Every non-independent Tawn / Joe-EV copula lacks a TP2 density (numerical).
sourceDiscrepancies.evidence: The unit-weight Tawn subfamily is Gumbel and has a TP2 density; the unit-weight Joe-EV subfamily is Galambos, whose TP2 status the paper marks unknown.
sourceDiscrepancies.verified_instead: Explicit non-TP2 members (tawn_witness_not_mtp2, joeExtremeValue_witness_not_mtp2, tEV_witness_not_mtp2) and the Gumbel TP2 correction.

verificationScope: The complete original arXiv v3 article is retained, with all eighteen numbered results, six tables, six figures and forty-four panels, appendix proofs and sixty references. Original source files and assets are byte-for-byte pinned. Rho, xi, survival CDF and lower-orthant definitions have independent typed encodings and checked bridges. The printed survival-copula lower-orthant proof is a checked proof document. Other markers expose compiled counterparts with their exact hypotheses, rather than certification of every printed proof step or every table cell. Definitions 2.2, 2.5 and 2.11 and the general elliptical Proposition 3.6 remain unbound; arbitrary-margin random-variable statements require further bridges. Table links collect audited family results, including corrected counterparts; they do not claim incorrect printed cells are true. Numerical plots, historical claims, excluded numerical-only observations and all remaining literal proof passages are not certified.
